title: Negroni
summary: A bold, bittersweet classic made with gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth.
steps: Add gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth to a mixing glass.
Add ice and stir until chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large cube.
Express orange peel over the drink and garnish.
notes: Equal parts is classic, but you can increase the gin slightly for a stronger, drier version.
